errors.text_span: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of samples across different levels of ambiguity standard deviation and maximum ambiguity. The chart is composed of six slices, arranged in a donut format.
errors.evidence: The chart is a nested donut chart with two concentric rings, not a single pie or donut chart. The outer ring has four slices and the inner ring has three slices, for a total of seven slices, not six.
The chart does not contain any pink slices; all slices are various shades of blue.

errors.text_span: another light blue slice labeled "Std: 0.94" occupies 7.0% of the donut
errors.evidence: The slice corresponding to "Std: 0.94" has a value of 5.0%, not 7.0%.

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored blue, represents "Std: 0.0" and occupies approximately 38.0% of the chart.
errors.evidence: The 38.0% slice is not the largest slice in the figure. The slices with values 49.0% and 47.7% in the inner ring are larger.

errors.text_span: one labeled "Max: 1" occupying approximately 5.0% and the other "Max: 2" with 39.0%
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The slice for "Max: 1" is 39.0%. The slice for "Max: 2" is 47.7%. The 5.0% slice belongs to the "Std: 0.94" category in the outer ring.
The description omits any mention of the two largest slices in the figure: the 49.0% slice (corresponding to "Max: 3") and the 47.7% slice (corresponding to "Max: 2").

errors.text_span: The light blue slices appear to be ordered from smallest to largest proportion.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The slices in both rings are ordered in descending order of size (largest to smallest). It is also ambiguous as to which 'light blue slices' it is referring to, as there are multiple shades.
